rationale: AAS scores highest (5) because TikTok/Shorts/Reels algorithms explicitly reward the engagement patterns AI video exploits — hooks, loops, novelty — amplifying at scale natively. PCA scores lowest (2) because fully synthetic video at deployable quality still requires meaningful compute cost and often manual prompt iteration or post-processing, keeping it closer to 1/10 than 1/100 cost reduction versus human production. EDP is high (4) due to deepfake/dubbing potential for political misinformation and non-consensual content, though not quite at the systemic infrastructure-harm level of, say, scientific record pollution.
